name: Alchemist
description: An Artificer specialized as a Alchemist.

name: Armorer
description: An Artificer specialized as a Armorer.

name: Artillerist
description: An Artificer specialized as a Artillerist.

name: Battle Smith
description: An Artificer specialized as a Battle Smith.

name: Cartographer
description: An Artificer specialized as a Cartographer.

name: Path of the Berserker
description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Berserker direct their Rage primarily toward violence. Their path is one of untrammeled fury, and they thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of their own well-being.

3.name: Frenzy
3.description: If you use Reckless Attack while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit on your turn with a Strength-based attack takes extra damage. Roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add the roll to the damage. The damage type is the same as the weapon's or strike's damage type.

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.description: You are immune to the Charmed and Frightened conditions while your Rage is active. If you have either condition when you enter your Rage, the condition is suspended for the duration of the Rage.

10.name: Retaliation
10.description: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to make one melee attack against that creature using a weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

14.name: Intimidating Presence
14.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the Frightened target can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: Path of the Wild Heart
description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the Wild Heart view themselves as kin to animals. These Barbarians learn magical means to communicate with animals, and their Rage heightens their connection to animals as it fills them with supernatural might.

3.name: Animal Speaker
3.description: You can cast the Beast Sense and Speak with Animals spells but only as Rituals. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them.

3.name: Rage of the Wilds
3.description:
Your Rage taps into the primal power of animals. Whenever you activate your Rage, you gain one of the following options of your choice:
Bear. While your Rage is active, you have Resistance to every damage type except Force, Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant.
Eagle. When you activate your Rage, you can take the Disengage and Dash actions as part of that Bonus Action. While your Rage is active, you can take a Bonus Action to take both of those actions.
Wolf. While your Rage is active, your allies have Advantage on attack rolls against any enemy of yours within 5 feet of you.

6.name: Aspect of the Wilds
6.description:
You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice:
Owl. You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. If you already have Darkvision, its range increases by 60 feet.
Panther. You have a Climb Speed equal to your Speed.
Salmon. You have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Nature's Envoy
10.description: You can cast the Commune with Nature spell but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

14.name: Power of the Wilds
14.description:
While your Rage is active, you gain one of the following options of your choice:
Bear. If a creature within 5 feet of you attacks an ally of yours, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.
Eagle. While your Rage is active, you have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed if you aren't wearing armor.
Wolf. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike on your turn, you can also force it to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or have the Prone condition.

name: Path of the Zealot
description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Zealot receive boons from a god or pantheon. These Barbarians experience their Rage as an ecstatic episode of divine union that infuses them with power. They are often allies to the priests and other followers of their god or pantheon.

3.name: Divine Fury
3.description: You can channel divine power into your strikes. On each of your turns while your Rage is active, the first creature you hit with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike takes extra damage equal to 1d6 plus half your Barbarian level (round down). The extra damage is Necrotic or Radiant; you choose the type each time you deal the damage.

3.name: Warrior of the Gods
3.description: A divine entity helps ensure you can continue the fight. You have a pool of four d12s that you can spend to heal yourself. As a Bonus Action, you can expend dice from the pool, roll them, and regain a number of Hit Points equal to the roll's total. Your pool regains all expended dice when you finish a Long Rest. The pool's maximum number of dice increases by one when you reach Barbarian levels 6 (5 dice), 12 (6 dice), and 17 (7 dice).

6.name: Fanatical Focus
6.description: Once per active Rage, if you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and you must use the new roll.

10.name: Zealous Presence
10.description: As a Bonus Action, you unleash a battle cry infused with divine energy. Up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet of you gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the start of your next turn. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

14.name: Rage of the Gods
14.description:
When you activate your Rage, you can assume the form of a divine warrior. This form lasts for 1 minute or until you drop to 0 Hit Points. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

While in this form, you gain the benefits below:
Flight. You have a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can hover.
Resistance. You have Resistance to Necrotic, Psychic, and Radiant damage.
Revivification. When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points, you can take a Reaction to expend a use of your Rage to instead change the target's Hit Points to a number equal to your Barbarian level.

name: Path of the World Tree
description: Barbarians who follow the Path of the World Tree connect with the cosmic tree Yggdrasil through their Rage. This tree grows among the Outer Planes, connecting them to each other and the Material Plane. These Barbarians draw on the tree's magic for vitality and as a means of dimensional travel.

3.name: Vitality of the Tree
3.description:
Your Rage taps into the life force of the World Tree. You gain the following benefits:
Vitality Surge. When you activate your Rage, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Barbarian level.
Life-Giving Force. At the start of each of your turns while your Rage is active, you can choose another creature within 10 feet of yourself to gain Temporary Hit Points. To determine the number of Temporary Hit Points, roll a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus, and add them together. If any of these Temporary Hit Points remain when your Rage ends, they vanish.

6.name: Branches of the Tree
6.description: Whenever a creature you can see starts its turn within 30 feet of you while your Rage is active, you can take a Reaction to summon spectral branches of the World Tree around it. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or be teleported to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of yourself or in the nearest unoccupied space you can see. After the target teleports, you can reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn.

10.name: Battering Roots
10.description: During your turn, your reach is 10 feet greater with any Melee weapon that has the Heavy or Versatile property, as tendrils of the World Tree extend from you. When you hit with such a weapon on your turn, you can activate the Push or Topple mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with that weapon.

14.name: Travel along the Tree
14.description: When you activate your Rage and as a Bonus Action while your Rage is active, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. In addition, once per Rage, you can increase the range of that teleport to 150 feet. When you do so, you can also bring up to six willing creatures who are within 10 feet of you. Each creature teleports to an unoccupied space of your choice within 10 feet of your destination space.

name: Path of the Ancestral Guardian
description: Some barbarians hail from cultures that revere their ancestors. These tribes teach that the warriors of the past linger in the world as mighty spirits, who can guide and protect the living.

3.name: Ancestral Protectors
3.description: Spectral warriors appear when you enter your Rage. While you're raging, the first creature you hit with an attack on your turn becomes the target of the warriors, which hinder its attacks. Until the start of your next turn, that target has disadvantage on any attack roll that isn't against you, and when the target hits a creature other than you with an attack, that creature has resistance to the damage dealt by the attack.

6.name: Spirit Shield
6.description: If you are raging and another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, you can use your Reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6. When you reach certain levels in this class, the damage reduction increases: 3d6 at 10th level and 4d6 at 14th level.

10.name: Consult the Spirits
10.description: You gain the ability to consult with your ancestral spirits. When you do so, you cast the Augury or Clairvoyance spell, without using a spell slot or material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for these spells. After you cast either spell in this way, you can't use this feature again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Vengeful Ancestors
14.description: Your ancestral spirits grow powerful enough to retaliate. When you use your Spirit Shield to reduce the damage of an attack, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount of damage your Spirit Shield prevents.

name: Path of the Storm Herald
description: All barbarians harbor a fury within. Their rage grants them superior strength, durability, and speed. Barbarians who follow the Path of the Storm Herald learn to transform that rage into a mantle of primal magic, which swirls around them.

3.name: Storm Aura
3.description:
When you enter your Rage, you summon a stormy aura that extends 10 feet from you in every direction. It ends if your Rage ends.
Choose Desert, Sea, or Tundra. You can change your choice whenever you gain a level in this class.
Desert. Any other creature in your aura takes 2 fire damage (increases to 3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).
Sea. Choose one other creature in your aura; it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Str mod + PB) or take 1d6 lightning damage (increases to 2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th).
Tundra. Any other creature of your choice in your aura gains 2 temporary hit points (increases to 3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).

6.name: Storm Soul
6.description:
You gain environmental benefits based on your Storm Aura choice:
Desert. Resistance to Fire damage. You don't suffer the effects of extreme heat.
Sea. Resistance to Lightning damage. You can breathe underwater and gain a swim speed of 30 feet.
Tundra. Resistance to Cold damage. You don't suffer the effects of extreme cold. You can freeze water as an action.

10.name: Shielding Storm
10.description: Each creature of your choice has resistance to the damage type associated with your Storm Soul feature while the creature is in your Storm Aura.

14.name: Raging Storm
14.description:
Your Storm Aura grows in power, granting a benefit when you hit or are hit by a creature:
Desert. Immediately after a creature in your Storm Aura hits you with an attack, you can use your Reaction to force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes fire damage equal to half your Barbarian level.
Sea. When you hit a creature in your Storm Aura with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is knocked prone.
Tundra. When your turn starts, you can choose one creature in your Storm Aura. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the end of your turn.

name: Path of the Beast
description: Barbarians who walk the Path of the Beast draw their rage from a bestial spark burning within their souls. That beast bursts forth in the throes of rage, physically transforming the barbarian.

3.name: Form of the Beast
3.description:
When you enter your Rage, you can manifest a natural weapon from your body (Bite, Claws, or Tail) that lasts until your Rage ends:
Bite. Your jaw transforms. It deals 1d8 piercing damage. Once on each of your turns when you damage a creature with this bite, if you have less than half your hit points, you regain hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Claws. Your hands become claws. They deal 1d6 slashing damage. When you take the Attack action and attack with a claw, you can make one additional claw attack as part of the same action.
Tail. You grow a tail. It deals 1d8 piercing damage and has the Reach property. If a creature you can see within 10 feet hits you with an attack roll, you can use your Reaction to add 1d8 to your AC for that attack.

6.name: Bestial Soul
6.description: The natural weapons of your Form of the Beast count as magic weapons for overcoming resistance and immunity. In addition, when you finish a Short or Long Rest, choose swim speed, climb speed, or increase jump distance until the next rest.

10.name: Infectious Fury
10.description: When you hit a creature with your natural weapons while raging, you can force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Str mod + PB). On a failed save, choose: the target must use its reaction to make a melee attack against a creature of your choice, or it takes 2d12 psychic damage. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

14.name: Call the Hunt
14.description: When you enter your Rage, you can choose willing creatures within 30 feet of you equal to your Constitution modifier. You gain 5 temporary hit points for each creature that accepts this feature. For the next minute, each of those creatures can roll an extra 1d6 damage when they hit a creature with an attack.

name: Path of Wild Magic
description: Many places in the multiverse abound with beauty, intense emotion, and rampant magic. These magic-suffused barbarians walk the Path of Wild Magic.

3.name: Magic Awareness
3.description: As an action, you can open your awareness to detect magic. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any spell or magic item within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all uses on a Long Rest.

3.name: Wild Magic Surge
3.description: When you enter your Rage, roll on the Wild Magic Surge table to determine the magical effect that erupts from you. If the effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + Con mod + PB.

6.name: Bolstering Magic
6.description:
You can harness your wild magic to bolster yourself or a companion. As an action, you can touch a creature and give it one of the following benefits:
- For 10 minutes, the creature can roll a d3 and add the number rolled to all attack rolls and ability checks.
- Roll a d3. The creature regains an expended spell slot of a level equal to or lower than the number rolled.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Unstable Backlash
10.description: When you take damage or fail a saving throw while raging, you can use your Reaction to roll on the Wild Magic Surge table. This effect immediately replaces your current Wild Magic effect.

14.name: Controlled Surge
14.description: Whenever you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you can roll twice and choose which of the two effects to unleash. If you roll the same number on both dice, you can choose any of the eight effects on the table.

name: College of Dance
description: Bards of the College of Dance know that the Words of Creation can't be contained within speech or song; the words are uttered by the movements of celestial bodies and flow through the motions of the smallest creatures. These Bards practice a way of being in harmony with the whirling cosmos that emphasizes agility, speed, and grace.

3.name: Dazzling Footwork
3.description:
While you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you gain the following benefits:
Dance Virtuoso. You have Advantage on any Charisma (Performance) check you make that involves you dancing.
Unarmored Defense. Your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.
Agile Strikes. When you expend a use of your Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
Bardic Damage. You can use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack rolls of your Unarmed Strikes. When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die plus your Dexterity modifier, instead of the strike's normal damage. This roll doesn't expend the die.

6.name: Inspiring Movement
6.description: When an enemy you can see ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to move up to half your Speed. Then one ally of your choice within 30 feet of you can also move up to half their Speed using their Reaction. None of this movement provokes Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Tandem Footwork
6.description: When you roll Initiative, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration if you don't have the Incapacitated condition. When you do so, roll your Bardic Inspiration die; you and each ally within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you gains a bonus to Initiative equal to the number rolled.

14.name: Lead the Evasion
14.description: When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail. If any creatures within 5 feet of you are making the same Dexterity saving throw, you can share this benefit with them for that save. You can't use this feature if you have the Incapacitated condition.

name: College of Glamour
description: The College of Glamour traces its origins to the beguiling magic of the Feywild. Bards who study this magic weave threads of beauty and terror into their songs and stories, and the mightiest among them can cloak themselves in otherworldly majesty.

3.name: Beguiling Magic
3.description: You always have the Charm Person and Mirror Image spells prepared. In addition, immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can cause a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself to make a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, the target has the Charmed or Frightened condition (your choice) for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending one use of your Bardic Inspiration (no action required).

3.name: Mantle of Inspiration
3.description: As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die. When you do so, choose a number of other creatures within 60 feet of yourself, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of those creatures gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to two times the number rolled on the Bardic Inspiration die, and then each can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Mantle of Majesty
6.description: You always have the Command spell prepared. As a Bonus Action, you cast Command without expending a spell slot, and you take on an unearthly appearance for 1 minute or until your Concentration ends. During this time, you can cast Command as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot. Any creature Charmed by you automatically fails its saving throw against the Command you cast with this feature. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore your use of it by expending a level 3+ spell slot (no action required).

14.name: Unbreakable Majesty
14.description: As a Bonus Action, you can assume a magically majestic presence for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. For the duration, whenever any creature hits you with an attack roll for the first time on a turn, the attacker must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC, or the attack misses instead, as the creature recoils from your majesty. Once you assume this majestic presence, you can't do so again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.

name: College of Lore
description: Bards of the College of Lore collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, such as scholarly tomes, mystical rites, and peasant tales. The college's members gather in libraries and universities to share their lore with one another.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll.

6.name: Magical Discoveries
6.description: You learn two spells from any class's spell list. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast (such as level 1, 2, or 3 spells). The chosen spells count as Bard spells for you and are always prepared. Whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of these spells with another spell that meets these requirements.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.

name: College of Valor
description: Bards of the College of Valor are daring storytellers whose tales preserve the memory of the great heroes of the past. These Bards sing the deeds of the mighty in vaulted halls or to crowds gathered around great bonfires.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with Medium armor, Shields, and Martial weapons.

3.name: Combat Inspiration
3.description:
A creature with your Bardic Inspiration die can use it in the following ways:
- Roll the die and add the number rolled to the damage roll of an attack.
- Roll the die and add the number to its AC as a Reaction when hit by an attack.

6.name: Extra Attack
6.description: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. You can cast one of your cantrips that has a casting time of an action in place of one of those attacks.

14.name: Battle Magic
14.description: After you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can make one attack with a weapon as a Bonus Action.

name: College of Swords
description: Bards of the College of Swords are called blades, and they entertain through daring feats of weapon prowess.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with Medium armor and the Scimitar. If you're proficient with a simple or martial melee weapon, you can use it as a spellcasting focus for your Bard spells.

3.name: Fighting Style
3.description: Choose one Fighting Style option: Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

3.name: Blade Flourish
3.description: Whenever you take the Attack action on your turn, your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the turn. If a weapon attack you make hits, you can expend one Bardic Inspiration use to perform a flourish (Defensive, Slashing, or Mobile).

6.name: Extra Attack
6.description: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

14.name: Master's Flourish
14.description: Whenever you use a Blade Flourish option, you can roll a d6 and use it instead of expending a Bardic Inspiration die.

name: College of Whispers
description: Most bards are happy to entertain audiences and perform acts of heroism. Bards of the College of Whispers use their knowledge and magic to uncover secrets and turn them against others through extortion and threats.

3.name: Psychic Blades
3.description: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration to deal an extra 2d6 psychic damage to that target. This increases to 3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, and 8d6 at 15th.

3.name: Words of Terror
3.description: If you speak to a humanoid alone for at least 1 minute, you can attempt to seed paranoia. It must make a Wisdom save or become Frightened of you or another creature for 1 hour. Once used, can't be used again until Short or Long Rest.

6.name: Mantle of Whispers
6.description: When a humanoid dies within 30 feet of you, you can capture its shadow using a Reaction. You can then adopt its persona and appearance for 1 hour, gaining its basic memories. Once used, can't be used again until Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Shadow Lore
14.description: As an action, you whisper a phrase to a creature within 30 feet. It must make a Wisdom save or be Charmed by you for 8 hours. Once used, can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.

name: College of Creation
description: Adherents of the College of Creation see the cosmos as a work of art, and they draw on the song of creation to animate objects and generate matter out of nothing.

3.name: Mote of Potential
3.description: Whenever you grant a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature, it gains a tiny mote of light. It can roll the die and get a benefit based on whether it is an Ability check, Attack roll, or Saving throw.

3.name: Performance of Creation
3.description: As an action, you can magically create one nonmagical item of your choice in an unoccupied space. The item's value cannot exceed 20 times your Bard level. It lasts for a number of hours equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once used, can't be used again until Long Rest or you expend a level 2+ slot.

6.name: Animating Performance
6.description: As an action, you can animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item, creating a Dancing Item that obeys your commands. It lasts for 1 hour. Once used, can't be used again until Long Rest or you expend a level 3+ slot.

14.name: Creative Crescendo
14.description: When you use your Performance of Creation, you can create more than one item: up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of two). Only one item can be of the maximum size.

name: College of Eloquence
description: Adherents of the College of Eloquence master the art of oratory, wielding a blend of logic and theatrical wordplay to win over their audiences.

3.name: Silver Tongue
3.description: You are a master at saying the right thing. When you roll a Persuasion or Deception check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

3.name: Unsettling Words
3.description: As a Bonus Action, expend one Bardic Inspiration use to choose a creature in 60 feet. Roll the die: subtract the roll from the creature's next saving throw.

6.name: Unfailing Inspiration
6.description: When a creature adds one of your Bardic Inspiration dice to a roll and fails the roll, the creature keeps the die instead of expending it.

6.name: Universal Speech
6.description: As an action, you can choose creatures in 60 feet up to your Charisma modifier. For 1 hour, they can understand you regardless of language. Once used, can't be used again until Long Rest or you expend a spell slot.

14.name: Infectious Inspiration
14.description: When a creature adds your Bardic Inspiration to a roll and succeeds, you can use your Reaction to grant Bardic Inspiration to a different creature within 60 feet without expending a use. You can do this Charisma modifier times per Long Rest.

name: Life Domain
description: The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life in the multiverse. Clerics who tap into this domain are masters of healing, using that life force to cure many hurts.

3.name: Life Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Life Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature regains additional Hit Points on the turn you cast the spell. The additional Hit Points equal 2 plus the spell slot's level.

3.name: Preserve Life
3.description: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to evoke healing energy that can restore a number of Hit Points equal to five times your Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30 feet of yourself (which can include you), and divide those Hit Points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half its Hit Point maximum.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: The healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. Immediately after you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores Hit Points to one or more creatures other than yourself, you regain Hit Points equal to 2 plus the spell slot's level.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore Hit Points to a creature with a spell or Channel Divinity, don't roll those dice for the healing; instead use the highest number possible for each die.

name: Light Domain
description: The Light Domain emphasizes the divine power to bring about blazing fire and revelation. Clerics who wield this power are enlightened souls infused with radiance and the power of their deities' discerning vision.

3.name: Light Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Light Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Radiance of the Dawn
3.description: As a Magic action, you present your Holy Symbol and expend a use of your Channel Divinity to emit a flash of light in a 30-foot Emanation originating from yourself. Any magical Darkness in that area is dispelled. Additionally, each creature of your choice in that area must make a Constitution saving throw, taking Radiant damage equal to 2d10 plus your Cleric level on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

3.name: Warding Flare
3.description: When a creature that you can see within 30 feet of yourself makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

6.name: Improved Warding Flare
6.description: You regain all expended uses of your Warding Flare when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, whenever you use Warding Flare, you can give the target of the triggering attack a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 plus your Wisdom modifier.

17.name: Corona of Light
17.description: As a Magic action, you can emit an aura of sunlight in a 60-foot Emanation originating from yourself. The aura lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. While the aura persists, enemies in it have Disadvantage on saving throws against spells that deal Fire or Radiant damage.

name: Trickery Domain
description: The Trickery Domain offers magic of deception, illusion, and stealth. Clerics of trickster deities are a disruptive force in the world, puncturing pride, mocking tyrants, and helping the oppressed.

3.name: Trickery Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Trickery Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Blessing of the Trickster
3.description: As a Magic action, you can touch a willing creature other than yourself to give it Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. This blessing lasts until you finish a Long Rest or use it again.

3.name: Invoke Duplicity
3.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to create a perfect illusion of yourself in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. It lasts for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 feet. While the illusion persists, you gain the benefits below:
- You can cast spells as though you were in the illusion's space.
- When both you and your illusion are within 5 feet of a creature that can see the illusion, you have Advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

6.name: Trickster's Transposition
6.description: Whenever you take the Bonus Action to move your Invoke Duplicity illusion, you can teleport, swap places with the illusion, and then move the illusion up to 30 feet.

17.name: Improved Duplicity
17.description: Your Invoke Duplicity illusion grows more powerful. You can now create up to two illusions at once, and when you or an ally attacks a creature within 5 feet of at least one of the illusions, the attacker has Advantage on the attack roll. In addition, when you swap places with an illusion using Trickster's Transposition, you can also teleport one willing ally within 5 feet of you to the illusion's previous space.

name: War Domain
description: The War Domain excels in combat, favoring deities of war, honor, and courage. Clerics of this domain are holy warriors who inspire their companions and strike down their enemies with divine force.

3.name: War Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the War Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: War Priest
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Guided Strike
3.description: When you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll and misses, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Channel Divinity to grant a +10 bonus to the attack roll, potentially turning a miss into a hit.

6.name: War God's Blessing
6.description: You can use your Guided Strike feature to bolster yourself or an ally without expending Channel Divinity, up to a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier. You regain all uses on a Long Rest.

17.name: Avatar of Battle
17.description: You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

name: Forge Domain
description: The gods of the forge are patrons of artisans who work with metal. Clerics of these deities seek to craft items, locate lost artifacts, and protect their communities with heavy armor and weapons.

3.name: Forge Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Forge Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

3.name: Blessing of the Forge
3.description: At the end of a Long Rest, you can touch one nonmagical object that is a suit of armor or a simple or martial weapon. Until the end of your next Long Rest or until you die, the object becomes a magic item, granting a +1 bonus to AC if it's armor or a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls if it's a weapon. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest.

3.name: Artisan's Blessing
3.description: You can use your Channel Divinity to conduct an hour-long ritual that crafts a nonmagical metal item worth no more than 100 gp. As part of this ritual, you must lay out metal, which can include coins, with a value equal to the creation.

6.name: Soul of the Forge
6.description:
Your mastery of the forge grants you special abilities:
- You gain resistance to fire damage.
- While wearing heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.

17.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
17.description:
Your blessed affinity with fire and metal becomes more powerful:
- You gain immunity to fire damage.
- While wearing heavy armor, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

name: Grave Domain
description: Gods of the grave watch over the line between life and death. Followers of these deities seek to put wandering spirits to rest, destroy the undead, and ease the suffering of the dying.

3.name: Grave Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Grave Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Circle of Mortality
3.description: When you would normally roll one or more dice to restore hit points with a spell to a creature at 0 hit points, you instead use the highest number possible for each die. In addition, you learn the Spare the Dying cantrip, which has a range of 30 feet and can be cast as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Eyes of the Grave
3.description: As an action, you can open your awareness to magically detect undead. Until the end of your next turn, you know the location of any undead within 60 feet of you that isn't behind total cover and isn't protected from divination magic. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.

3.name: Path to the Grave
3.description: As an action, you choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you, expending a use of Channel Divinity to curse it until the end of your next turn. The next time you or an ally of yours hits the cursed creature with an attack, the creature has vulnerability to all of that attack's damage, and then the curse ends.

6.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
6.description: As a Reaction when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you suffers a critical hit, you can turn that hit into a normal hit. Any effects triggered by a critical hit are canceled. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.

17.name: Keeper of Souls
17.description: When an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet of you, you or one creature of your choice that is within 60 feet of you regains hit points equal to the enemy's number of Hit Dice. You can use this feature only if you aren't incapacitated. Once you use it, you can't do so again until the start of your next turn.

name: Order Domain
description: The Order Domain represents discipline, as well as devotion to the laws that govern a society, an institution, or a philosophy.

3.name: Order Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Order Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with heavy armor. You also gain proficiency in the Intimidation or Persuasion skill (your choice).

3.name: Voice of Authority
3.description: If you cast a spell of level 1+ with a spell slot and target an ally, that ally can use their Reaction to make one weapon attack against a target of your choice.

3.name: Order's Demand
3.description: As an action, present your Holy Symbol and expend one Channel Divinity to force each creature of your choice within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is Charmed by you until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage. You can also force a Charmed creature to drop what it is holding.

6.name: Embodiment of the Law
6.description: When you cast an Enchantment spell of level 1+ that has a casting time of 1 Action, you can cast it as a Bonus Action. You can do this Wisdom modifier times per Long Rest.

17.name: Order's Wrath
17.description: When you hit a creature with your Divine Strike or deal damage to it with a Cleric spell, select an ally: they deal an extra 2d8 force damage on their next hit against it.

name: Peace Domain
description: The Peace Domain inspires people to resolve conflict and stand up against forces that try to prevent peace from flourishing.

3.name: Peace Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Peace Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Implement of Peace
3.description: You gain proficiency in the Insight, Performance, or Persuasion skill (your choice).

3.name: Emboldening Bond
3.description: As an action, touch two creatures (or yourself and one other). For 10 minutes, once per turn, when within 30 feet of each other, they can add 1d4 to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. Can be used Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

3.name: Balm of Peace
3.description: As an action, you can use your Channel Divinity to move up to your Speed. This movement doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks, and when you move within 5 feet of any creature, you can heal it by 2d6 + Wisdom modifier.

6.name: Protective Bond
6.description: When a creature affected by your Emboldening Bond takes damage, another bonded creature within 30 feet can use its Reaction to teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target and take the damage instead.

17.name: Expansive Bond
17.description: The range of your Emboldening Bond increases to 60 feet. In addition, when a bonded creature teleports using Protective Bond, it gains Resistance to the damage of the triggering attack.

name: Twilight Domain
description: The Twilight Domain guards the transition from day to night, offering rest, comfort, and protection against the horrors of the dark.

3.name: Twilight Domain Spells
3.description: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Twilight Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

3.name: Eyes of Night
3.description: You gain Darkvision with a range of 300 feet. As an action, you can magically share this darkvision with willing creatures within 10 feet of you for 1 hour. Once you share it, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a spell slot of any level.

3.name: Vigilant Blessing
3.description: As an action, you touch a creature (which can be yourself) and give it Advantage on its next Initiative roll. This benefit ends once Initiative is rolled or you use this feature again.

3.name: Twilight Sanctuary
3.description: As a Magic action, present your Holy Symbol and expend Channel Divinity to create a 30-foot sphere of twilight centered on you that moves with you for 1 minute. At the end of an ally's turn in it, you can grant it 1d6 + Cleric level temp HP or end the Charmed or Frightened condition on it.

6.name: Steps of Night
6.description: As a Bonus Action while you are in dim light or darkness, you can give yourself a Fly Speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. You can do this Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest.

17.name: Twilight Shroud
17.description: The twilight that you summon offers a protective embrace: you and your allies have Half Cover while in the sphere created by your Twilight Sanctuary.

name: Circle of the Land
description: The Circle of the Land comprises mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites. These Druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic.

options.name: Land Type
options.description: Choose a type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you have the spells listed for that land prepared.

choices.name: Arid Land
choices.description: You prepare the spells associated with the Arid Land type: Blur, Burning Hands, Fire Bolt, Fireball, Blight, and Wall of Stone.

choices.name: Polar Land
choices.description: You prepare the spells associated with the Polar Land type: Fog Cloud, Hold Person, Ray of Frost, Sleet Storm, Ice Storm, and Cone of Cold.

choices.name: Temperate Land
choices.description: You prepare the spells associated with the Temperate Land type: Misty Step, Shocking Grasp, Sleep, Lightning Bolt, Freedom of Movement, and Tree Stride.

choices.name: Tropical Land
choices.description: You prepare the spells associated with the Tropical Land type: Acid Splash, Ray of Sickness, Web, Stinking Cloud, Polymorph, and Insect Plague.

3.name: Circle of the Land Spells
3.description: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.

3.name: Land's Aid
3.description:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and choose a point within 60 feet of yourself. Vitality-giving flowers and life-draining thorns appear for a moment in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point. Each creature of your choice in the Sphere must make a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC, taking 2d6 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. One creature of your choice in that area regains 2d6 Hit Points.
The damage and healing increase by 1d6 when you reach Druid levels 10 (3d6) and 14 (4d6).

6.name: Natural Recovery
6.description:
You can cast one of the level 1+ spells that you have prepared from your Circle Spells feature without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a Long Rest before you do so again.
In addition, when you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your Druid level (round up), and none of them can be level 6+. Once you recover spell slots with this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.description: You are immune to the Poisoned condition, and you have Resistance to a damage type associated with your current land choice in the Circle Spells feature, as shown in the Nature's Ward table: Arid (Fire), Polar (Cold), Temperate (Lightning), Tropical (Poison).

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.description:
As a Magic action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape and cause spectral trees and vines to appear in a 15-foot Cube on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. They last there for 1 minute or until you have the Incapacitated condition or die. You and your allies have Half Cover while in that area, and your allies gain the current Resistance of your Nature's Ward while there.
As a Bonus Action, you can move the Cube up to 60 feet to ground within 120 feet of yourself.

name: Circle of the Moon
description: Druids of the Circle of the Moon draw on lunar magic to transform themselves. Their order gathers under the moon to share news and perform rituals.

3.name: Circle Forms
3.description:
You can channel lunar magic when you assume a Wild Shape form, granting you the benefits below.
Challenge Rating. The maximum Challenge Rating for the form equals your Druid level divided by 3 (round down).
Armor Class. Until you leave the form, your AC equals 13 plus your Wisdom modifier if that total is higher than the Beast's AC.
Temporary Hit Points. You gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to three times your Druid level.
You can cast the spells from Circle of the Moon Spells while you're in a Wild Shape form.

6.name: Improved Circle Forms
6.description:
While in a Wild Shape form, you gain the following benefits.
Lunar Radiance. Each of your attacks in a Wild Shape form can deal its normal damage type or Radiant damage. You make this choice each time you hit with those attacks.
Increased Toughness. You can add your Wisdom modifier to your Constitution saving throws.

10.name: Moonlight Step
10.description:
You magically transport yourself, reappearing amid a burst of moonlight. As a Bonus Action, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, and you have Advantage on the next attack roll you make before the end of this turn.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also regain uses by expending a level 2+ spell slot for each use you want to restore (no action required).

14.name: Lunar Form
14.description:
The power of the moon suffuses you, granting you the following benefits.
Improved Lunar Radiance. Once per turn, you can deal an extra 2d10 Radiant damage to a target you hit with a Wild Shape form's attack.
Shared Moonlight. Whenever you use Moonlight Step, you can also teleport one willing creature. That creature must be within 10 feet of you, and you teleport it to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of your destination space.

name: Circle of the Sea
description: Druids of the Circle of the Sea draw on the tempestuous forces of oceans and storms. Some view themselves as embodiments of nature's wrath, seeking vengeance against those who despoil nature. Others seek mystical unity with nature by attuning themselves to the ebb and flow of the tides.

3.name: Wrath of the Sea
3.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape to manifest a 5-foot Emanation that takes the form of ocean spray that surrounds you for 10 minutes. It ends early if you dismiss it (no action required), manifest it again, or have the Incapacitated condition.
When you manifest the Emanation and as a Bonus Action on your subsequent turns, you can choose another creature you can see in the Emanation. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or take Cold damage and, if the creature is Large or smaller, be pushed up to 15 feet away from you. To determine this damage, roll a number of d6s equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one die).

6.name: Aquatic Affinity
6.description: The size of the Emanation created by your Wrath of the Sea increases to 10 feet. In addition, you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

10.name: Stormborn
10.description:
Your Wrath of the Sea confers two more benefits while active, as detailed below.
Flight. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.
Resistance. You have Resistance to Cold, Lightning, and Thunder damage.

14.name: Oceanic Gift
14.description:
Instead of manifesting the Emanation of Wrath of the Sea around yourself, you can manifest it around one willing creature within 60 feet of yourself. That creature gains all the benefits of the Emanation and uses your spell save DC and Wisdom modifier for it.
In addition, you can manifest the Emanation around both the other creature and yourself if you expend two uses of your Wild Shape instead of one when manifesting it.

name: Circle of Stars
description: The Circle of the Stars has tracked heavenly patterns since time immemorial, discovering secrets hidden amid the constellations. By understanding these secrets, the Druids of this circle seek to harness the powers of the cosmos.

3.name: Star Map
3.description:
You've created a star chart as part of your heavenly studies. It is a Tiny object, and you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your Druid spells. While holding the map, you always have the Guidance and Guiding Bolt spells prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
If you lose the map, you can perform a 1-hour ceremony during a Short or Long Rest to magically create a replacement, which destroys the previous map.

3.name: Starry Form
3.description:
As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to take on a starry form rather than shape-shifting. It lasts for 10 minutes or until dismissed, incapacitated, or used again. It sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. When you assume it, choose one of the following constellations:
Archer. You can make a ranged spell attack as a Bonus Action on your turns, targeting a creature within 60 feet and dealing Radiant damage equal to 1d8 + Wisdom modifier.
Chalice. Whenever you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores HP to a creature, you or another creature within 30 feet can regain HP equal to 1d8 + Wisdom modifier.
Dragon. When you make an Intelligence/Wisdom check or Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

6.name: Cosmic Omen
6.description:
Whenever you finish a Long Rest, consult your Star Map for omens and roll a die. Until you finish your next Long Rest, you gain access to a special Reaction based on whether you rolled an even or an odd number on the die:
Weal (Even). Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and add the number rolled to the total.
Woe (Odd). Whenever a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is about to make a D20 Test, you can take a Reaction to roll 1d6 and subtract the number rolled from the total.
You can use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

10.name: Twinkling Constellations
10.description: The constellations of your Starry Form improve. The 1d8 of the Archer and the Chalice becomes 2d8, and while the Dragon is active, you have a Fly Speed of 20 feet and can hover. Moreover, at the start of each of your turns while in your Starry Form, you can change which constellation glimmers on your body.

14.name: Full of Stars
14.description: While in your Starry Form, you become partially incorporeal, giving you Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Circle of Dreams
description: Druids who are members of the Circle of Dreams hail from regions that have strong ties to the Feywild and its dreamlike realms. These druids seek to fill the world with dreamy wonder. Their magic mends wounds and brings joy to downcast hearts, and the realms they protect are gleaming, fruitful places, where dream and reality blur together.

3.name: Balm of the Summer Court
3.description:
You become imbued with the blessings of the Summer Court. You have a pool of fey energy represented by a number of d6s equal to your druid level.
As a bonus action, you can choose one creature you can see within 120 feet of you and spend a number of those dice equal to half your druid level or less. Roll the spent dice and add them together. The target regains a number of hit points equal to the total plus 1 temporary hit point per die spent. You regain all expended dice when you finish a long rest.

6.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
6.description: During a short or long rest, you can touch a point in space to create an invisible, 30-foot-radius sphere of magic. Total cover blocks the sphere. While within the sphere, you and your allies gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) and Wisdom (Perception) checks, and any light from open flames in the sphere isn’t visible outside it. The sphere vanishes at the end of the rest or when you leave it.

10.name: Hidden Paths
10.description:
As a bonus action on your turn, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Alternatively, you can use your action to teleport one willing creature you touch up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses of it when you finish a long rest.

14.name: Walker in Dreams
14.description: When you finish a short rest, you can cast one of the following spells, without expending a spell slot or requiring material components: dream (with you as the messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle (opening a portal to the last location where you finished a long rest on your current plane of existence). Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Circle of the Shepherd
description: Druids of the Circle of the Shepherd commune with the spirits of nature, especially the spirits of beasts and the fey, and call to those spirits for aid. These druids focus on protecting animals and fey creatures that have difficulty defending themselves.

3.name: Speech of the Woods
3.description: You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan. In addition, beasts can understand your speech, and you gain the ability to decipher their noises and motions.

3.name: Spirit Totem
3.description:
As a bonus action, you can magically summon an incorporeal spirit to a point you can see within 60 feet of you. The spirit creates an aura in a 30-foot radius. It counts as neither a creature nor an object. You can move it up to 60 feet as a bonus action. The spirit persists for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest. Choose one of the following spirit types when summoned:
Bear Spirit. You and your allies in the aura gain temporary hit points equal to 5 + your druid level, and advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
Hawk Spirit. You can use your reaction to grant advantage to an attack roll against a target in the aura. You and your allies also have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks in the aura.
Unicorn Spirit. You and your allies gain advantage on all ability checks made to detect creatures in the aura. In addition, if you cast a spell with a spell slot that restores HP to a creature, each creature of your choice in the aura also regains HP equal to your druid level.

6.name: Mighty Summoner
6.description:
Beasts and fey that you conjure are more resilient than normal. Any beast or fey summoned or created by a spell you cast gains the following benefits:
- The creature appears with 2 extra hit points per Hit Die it has.
- The damage from its natural weapons is considered magical for the purpose of overcoming immunity and resistance to nonmagical attacks and damage.

10.name: Guardian Spirit
10.description: When a beast or fey that you summoned or created with a spell ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura, that creature regains a number of hit points equal to half your druid level.

14.name: Faithful Summons
14.description: If you are reduced to 0 hit points or are incapacitated against your will, you can immediately gain the benefits of conjure animals as if it were cast using a 9th-level spell slot. It summons four beasts of your choice that are CR 2 or lower within 20 feet of you. The spell lasts for 1 hour, requiring no concentration. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Circle of Spores
description: Druids of the Circle of Spores find beauty in decay. They see within mold and other fungi the ability to transform lifeless material into abundant, albeit somewhat strange, life. They believe that life and death are parts of a grand cycle.

3.name: Circle of Spores Spells
3.description: Your symbiotic link to fungi grants you access to certain spells. You learn the Chill Touch cantrip. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to the spells listed in the Circle of Spores Spells table.

3.name: Halo of Spores
3.description: You are surrounded by invisible, necrotic spores. When a creature you can see moves into a space within 10 feet of you or starts its turn there, you can use your reaction to deal 1d4 necrotic damage to that creature unless it succeeds on a Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC. The necrotic damage increases to 1d6 at 6th level, 1d8 at 10th level, and 1d10 at 14th level.

3.name: Symbiotic Entity
3.description:
As an action, you can expend a use of your Wild Shape feature to awaken your spores rather than transforming into a beast form. You gain 4 temporary hit points for each level you have in this class. While this feature is active, you gain the following benefits:
- When you deal your Halo of Spores damage, roll the damage die a second time and add it to the total.
- Your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage to any target they hit.
These benefits last for 10 minutes, until you lose all these temporary hit points, or until you use your Wild Shape again.

6.name: Fungal Infestation
6.description: Your spores gain the ability to infest a corpse and animate it. If a beast or a humanoid that is Small or Medium dies within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to animate it, causing it to stand up immediately with 1 hit point as a Zombie. It remains animate for 1 hour. It takes its turn immediately after yours and only takes the Attack action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once) per Long Rest.

10.name: Spreading Spores
10.description: As a bonus action while your Symbiotic Entity is active, you can hurl spores up to 30 feet away, swirling in a 10-foot cube for 1 minute. Whenever a creature moves into the cube or starts its turn there, it takes your Halo of Spores damage (Constitution save negates). While the cube persists, you can't use your Halo of Spores reaction.

14.name: Fungal Body
14.description: The fungal spores in your body alter you: you can't be blinded, deafened, frightened, or poisoned, and any critical hit against you counts as a normal hit instead, unless you're incapacitated.

name: Circle of Wildfire
description: Druids within the Circle of Wildfire understand that destruction is sometimes the precursor of creation, such as when a forest fire promotes later growth. These druids bond with a primal spirit that harbors both destructive and creative power.

3.name: Circle of Wildfire Spells
3.description: You have formed a bond with a wildfire spirit. Your link with this spirit grants you access to spells at certain levels, as shown in the Circle of Wildfire Spells table.

3.name: Summon Wildfire Spirit
3.description: As an action, you can expend one use of your Wild Shape feature to summon your wildfire spirit rather than assuming a beast form. The spirit appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet when it appears (except you) must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 fire damage. The spirit is friendly and obeys your commands. It shares your initiative count but takes its turn immediately after yours. It lasts for 1 hour, until reduced to 0 HP, or until you die.

6.name: Enhanced Bond
6.description: Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage or restores hit points while your wildfire spirit is summoned, roll a d8, and you gain a bonus equal to the number rolled to one damage or healing roll of the spell. In addition, when you cast a spell with a range other than self, the spell can originate from you or your wildfire spirit.

10.name: Cauterizing Flames
10.description: When a Small or larger creature dies within 30 feet of you or your wildfire spirit, a harmless spectral flame flickers there for 1 minute. When a creature enters that space, you can use your reaction to extinguish the flame and either heal that creature or deal fire damage to it equal to 2d10 + your Wisdom modifier. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per Long Rest.

14.name: Blazing Revival
14.description: If your wildfire spirit is within 120 feet of you when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can cause the spirit to drop to 0 hit points. You then regain half your maximum hit points and rise to your feet. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

name: Battle Master
description: Battle Masters are students of the art of battle, combining martial techniques with academic study.

3.name: Combat Superiority
3.description: You learn three maneuvers of your choice from the Maneuver Options. You learn two additional maneuvers at levels 7, 10, and 15. You have four Superiority Dice, which are d8s. You regain all expended Superiority Dice when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You gain an additional die at level 7 and level 15. Maneuver saving throw DC = 8 + Strength or Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

3.name: Student of War
3.description: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Fighter skill list.

7.name: Know Your Enemy
7.description: As a Bonus Action, you can discern whether a creature you can see within 30 feet has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and what they are. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest. You can also restore a use by expending one Superiority Die (no action required).

10.name: Improved Combat Superiority
10.description: Your Superiority Die becomes a d10.

15.name: Relentless
15.description: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use the number rolled instead of expending a Superiority Die.

18.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
18.description: Your Superiority Die becomes a d12.

name: Champion
description: A Champion focuses on the development of raw physical power and lethal prowess in combat.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Your weapon attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

3.name: Remarkable Athlete
3.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls. In addition, when you score a critical hit, you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

7.name: Additional Fighting Style
7.description: You gain another Fighting Style feat of your choice.

10.name: Heroic Warrior
10.description: Whenever you start your turn in combat and don't have Advantage on any attack roll, you can give yourself Heroic Inspiration. You can use it only during the current turn.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Your weapon attack rolls score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description:
You have Resistance to death itself. At the start of each of your turns in combat, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half your Hit Points remaining. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 Hit Points.
In addition, you have Advantage on Death saving throws.

name: Eldritch Knight
description: Eldritch Knights combine martial mastery with the study of arcane magic.

3.name: Spellcasting
3.description: You have learned to cast spells. See chapter 7 for the rules on spellcasting. You prepare the list of spells from the Wizard spell list.

3.name: War Bond
3.description: You learn a ritual that creates a magical bond between yourself and one weapon. You perform the ritual over 1 hour (can be during a Short Rest). Once bonded, you can't be disarmed of that weapon unless you are Incapacitated, and you can summon it as a Bonus Action to teleport it to your hand. You can bond up to two weapons, but summon only one at a time.

7.name: War Magic
7.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with a casting of one of your Wizard cantrips that has a casting time of an action.

10.name: Eldritch Strike
10.description: When you hit a creature with an attack using a weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

15.name: Arcane Charge
15.description: When you use your Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action.

18.name: Improved War Magic
18.description: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace two of the attacks with a casting of one of your level 1 or level 2 Wizard spells that has a casting time of an action.

name: Psi Warrior
description: Psi Warriors awaken the power of their minds to augment their physical might with telekinetic and psionic power.

3.name: Psionic Power
3.description:
You harbor a wellspring of psionic energy within yourself, represented by Psionic Energy Dice. You regain one die on a Short Rest, and all on a Long Rest. You start with 4 d6 dice at level 3, scaling as shown in the subclass description. You gain the following options:
Protective Field. As a Reaction when you or another creature within 30 feet takes damage, expend one Psionic Energy Die, roll it, and reduce the damage by the roll + Intelligence modifier (minimum 1).
Psionic Strike. Once per turn when you hit a target within 30 feet with a weapon attack, expend one Psionic Energy Die to deal extra Force damage equal to the roll + Intelligence modifier.
Telekinetic Movement. As a Magic action, transport a loose object (Large or smaller) or willing creature within 30 feet up to 30 feet. Once used, can't be used again until Short/Long rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die (no action required).

7.name: Telekinetic Adept
7.description:
You have mastered new ways to use your telekinetic abilities:
Psi-Powered Leap. As a Bonus Action, you gain a Fly Speed equal to twice your Speed until the end of the current turn. Once used, can't be used again until Short/Long rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die.
Telekinetic Thrust. When you deal damage with Psionic Strike, force the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + Int modifier + PB) or be knocked Prone or moved 10 feet horizontally.

10.name: Guarded Mind
10.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage. Moreover, if you start your turn Charmed or Frightened, you can expend one Psionic Energy Die (no action required) to end those conditions on yourself.

15.name: Bulwark of Force
15.description: As a Bonus Action, choose creatures (including you) within 30 feet up to your Intelligence modifier. Each gains Half Cover for 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated. Once used, can't be used again until Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die.

18.name: Telekinetic Master
18.description: You always have the Telekinesis spell prepared and can cast it without a slot or components (Intelligence is ability). While maintaining concentration on it, you can make one weapon attack as a Bonus Action. Once used, can't be used again until Long Rest unless you expend a Psionic Energy Die.

name: Arcane Archer
description: An Arcane Archer studies a unique elven method of archery that weaves magic into attacks to produce supernatural effects.

3.name: Arcane Archer Lore
3.description: You gain proficiency in either Arcana or Nature, and learn either the Prestidigitation or Druidcraft cantrip.

3.name: Arcane Shot
3.description: You learn two Arcane Shot options. Once per turn when you fire a magic arrow from a shortbow or longbow as part of the Attack action, you can apply one option. You have 2 uses, which you regain on a Short or Long Rest. You learn additional options at levels 7, 10, 15, and 18.

7.name: Magic Arrow
7.description: Whenever you fire a nonmagical arrow from a shortbow or longbow, you can make it magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

7.name: Curving Shot
7.description: When you make an attack roll with a magic arrow and miss, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against a different target within 60 feet.

10.name: Arcane Shot (4 options)
10.description: You now know four Arcane Shot options.

15.name: Ever-Ready Shot
15.description: If you roll initiative and have no uses of Arcane Shot remaining, you regain one use.

18.name: Improved Arcane Shot
18.description: You know six Arcane Shot options, and their magical damage increases.

name: Cavalier
description: The archetypal Cavalier excels at mounted combat, protecting allies and locking down enemies in battle.

3.name: Bonus Proficiency
3.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or learn one language.

3.name: Born to the Saddle
3.description: You have advantage on saving throws to avoid falling off your mount. Landing on your feet after falling off requires no more than 10 feet of descent, and mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

3.name: Unwavering Mark
3.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it. While within 5 feet of you, it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone else. If it deals damage to someone else, you can make a special bonus action melee attack against it on your next turn (with advantage and extra damage equal to half your fighter level). You can make this special attack a number of times equal to your Strength modifier per Long Rest.

7.name: Warding Maneuver
7.description: When you or a creature within 5 feet is hit by an attack, roll 1d8 as a reaction (if wielding melee weapon or shield) and add it to the AC against that attack. If it still hits, the target has resistance to the damage. Can be used Constitution modifier times per Long Rest.

10.name: Hold the Line
10.description: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks when they move 5 feet or more within your reach. If hit, their speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn.

15.name: Ferocious Charger
15.description: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line before hitting a creature with an attack, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 8 + PB + Strength modifier) or be knocked Prone.

18.name: Vigilant Defender
18.description: In combat, you get a special reaction you can take on every creature's turn (except yours) to make an opportunity attack.

name: Samurai
description: The Samurai is a fighter who draws on an implacable fighting spirit to overcome enemies and excel in battle and court.

3.name: Bonus Proficiency
3.description: You gain proficiency in one of the following skills: History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or learn one language.

3.name: Fighting Spirit
3.description: As a bonus action, give yourself advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the turn and gain 5 temporary hit points (increases to 10 at level 10, 15 at level 15). You have 3 uses per Long Rest.

7.name: Elegant Courtier
7.description: Add Wisdom modifier to Charisma (Persuasion) checks. You also gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws (or Intelligence/Charisma if already proficient).

10.name: Tireless Spirit
10.description: When you roll initiative and have no uses of Fighting Spirit remaining, you regain one use.

15.name: Rapid Strike
15.description: If you attack with advantage on your turn, you can forgo it to make an additional weapon attack as part of the same action (once per turn).

18.name: Strength before Death
18.description: If you take damage that reduces you to 0 hit points and doesn't kill you outright, use your reaction to delay falling unconscious and take an extra turn immediately. Once used, can't be used again until a Long Rest.

name: Rune Knight
description: Rune Knights enhance their martial prowess using the supernatural power of runes, an ancient practice originated with giants.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: You gain proficiency with smith's tools and learn to speak, read, and write Giant.

3.name: Rune Carver
3.description: You learn two runes. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can inscribe runes onto objects (weapons, armor, shield, jewelry). Runes include: Cloud Rune, Fire Rune, Frost Rune, Stone Rune, Hill Rune (level 7), and Storm Rune (level 7). Each grants passive benefits and an active effect.

3.name: Giant's Might
3.description: As a bonus action, you magically become Large (if smaller), gain advantage on Strength checks/saves, and once per turn deal an extra 1d6 damage with a weapon/unarmed strike. Lasts 1 minute. Can be used PB times per Long Rest.

7.name: Runic Shield
7.description: When a creature within 60 feet is hit by an attack, use your reaction to force the attacker to reroll the d20. Can be used PB times per Long Rest.

10.name: Great Stature
10.description: You permanently grow 3d4 inches. The extra damage of Giant's Might increases to 1d8.

15.name: Master of Runes
15.description: You can invoke each rune twice rather than once per Short or Long Rest.

18.name: Runic Juggernaut
18.description: Giant's Might damage increases to 1d10, you can become Huge, and your reach increases by 5 feet.

name: Warrior of Mercy
description: Monks of the Way of Mercy learn to manipulate the life force of others to bring aid to those in need and to end the suffering of their enemies.

name: Warrior of Shadow
description: Monks of the Way of Shadow value the arts of stealth and subterfuge, often serving as spies and assassins.

name: Warrior of the Elements
description: Monks of the Way of the Elements draw on the elemental forces of the multiverse to enhance their attacks and defenses.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
description: Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed.

name: Oath of Devotion
description: The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice and order, standing as the classic knight in shining armor.

3.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
3.description: The magic of your oath ensures you always have certain spells ready; when you reach a Paladin level specified in the Oath of Devotion Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

3.name: Sacred Weapon
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon you are holding with positive energy. For 10 minutes, add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls (minimum +1), the weapon deals its normal type or Radiant damage (your choice), and emits Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light 20 feet beyond.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and your allies have Immunity to the Charmed condition while in your Aura of Protection.

15.name: Smite of Protection
15.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and your allies have Half Cover while in your Aura of Protection until the start of your next turn.
